title: Normalized rational closed term and proper adjunction unit
statement: Fix the finite-field datum D and coefficient data l and E as in [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex]. For a separated finite-type model X₀ and finite-type Z₀ with a closed immersion i₀:Z₀→X₀, let i be its actual geometric base change. Suppose P and Q are the integral and rational presentations normalized as in [def-sf-recollement-presentation-data]. There is a natural isomorphism from Q.closedTerm to fieldWeilPull(i₀) followed by fieldWeilProper(i₀), the actual rational pullback and its specified right adjoint of [def-zl-field-weil-shriek-shift-data]. For every object K the composite of Q.unit at K with this isomorphism is precisely the unit of fieldWeilProperAdj at K. This is an identification of functors with their prescribed units; no Frobenius structure or open square is asserted.

proof.text: The quotient-normalized immersion comparison identifies ordinary exact completed-ring inverse image with the specified completed pullback. Closed direct image is exact; derive the actual module adjunction and restrict it to the full integral constructible categories. This gives the same closed composite and the same unit as in the integral normalization, first on complexes and then on all objects by essential surjectivity and naturality.

proof.text: Raw scalar localization transports the integral adjunction and unit. Its object map is unchanged, and tensor bilinearity extends naturality from integral arrows to all rational arrows. Uniqueness of right adjoints identifies the rationalized image with fieldWeilProper, with unit equation unit_rightAdjointUniq_hom_app. Compose with the closed natural isomorphism in the rational normalization of Q. The two unit equations give the displayed equation. The same construction applies to the empty closed scheme and zero objects.

theorem sfNormalizedRationalRecollement_closed_comparison
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (X₀ Z₀ : Over (Spec (.of D.k₀)))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X₀.hom] [QuasiCompact X₀.hom] [IsSeparated X₀.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType Z₀.hom] [QuasiCompact Z₀.hom]
    (i₀ : Z₀ ⟶ X₀) [IsClosedImmersion i₀.left]
    (i : (D.geometricFiber Z₀).left ⟶ (D.geometricFiber X₀).left)
    [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (_hi : i = ((Over.pullback
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap D.k₀ D.k)))).map i₀).left)
    (P : SfRecollementPresentation
      (sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E (D.geometricFiber X₀).left))
    (Q : SfRecollementPresentation
      (sfRationalConstructibleCategory l E (D.geometricFiber X₀).left))
    (_hP : SfIntegralRecollementNormalization l E i (sfRecollementGeometricNoetherian D X₀) P)
    (_hQ : SfRationalRecollementNormalization l E (D.geometricFiber X₀).left P Q) :
    ∃ c : Q.closedTerm ≅ fieldWeilPull D l hl E i₀ ⋙ fieldWeilProper D l hl E i₀,
      ∀ K, Q.unit.app K ≫ c.hom.app K = (fieldWeilProperAdj D l hl E i₀).unit.app K
